title: CAD IR Phase 13 — Process-aware machine-time cost
summary: Phased implementation spec adding process-specific machine-time charges (laser_cut/cnc/print_3d/sheet_metal_bend) on top of Phase 12's material-only fabrication cost.
notes: Hybrid plan/spec doc under /plans/ — defines technical contracts (interfaces, Zod schemas, function signatures, cost formulas) for a phased build. SPEC chosen over DOC because the load-bearing content is implementation contracts the system must honor; tutorial-like step structure is secondary. Not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences trade-off) and not a PRD (no user stories/business requirements).
